symptom: PC cannot ping the default gateway
topology_note: PC0 connected to Fa0/1 on Switch1 which connects to Router0 Gi0/0
show_output:
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.0
 shutdown
!
expected_fault: Interface shutdown on router uplink
correct_answer: Bring up the interface: no shutdown on Gi0/0

topology_note: DHCP server configured on Router0; clients on VLAN 10
show_output:
Router0# show ip dhcp pool

!
Router0# show run | section dhcp
no ip dhcp pool VLAN10

correct_answer: Configure DHCP pool: ip dhcp pool VLAN10; network 192.168.10.0 255.255.255.0; default-router 192.168.10.1

symptom: PC gets IP but cannot browse websites
expected_fault: DNS server not configured
correct_answer: Set DNS server on DHCP pool: dns-server 8.8.8.8
